title: Stable softmax and cross-entropy
summary: Batched softmax, mean cross-entropy and its gradient, without overflow for large logits.

mutants.global_max: Takes the maximum and the sum over the whole batch, not over each row.
mutants.grad_missing_onehot: Returns softmax divided by N and forgets to subtract the one-hot target.
mutants.in_place_shift: Subtracts the maximum in place, so the caller's logits change.
mutants.no_max_shift: Calls np.exp on the raw logits, so large logits overflow to infinity.
mutants.sum_not_mean: Sums the example losses and gradients and does not divide by N.
